title: Newtonian truth and model on an inclined orbit: recovers GM and the 6-state
description: One 12 h coasting arc around A in a Newtonian world, on an orbit inclined 50 deg. The fit recovers mu.A from an arrival prior 2% off and all six state components; the unneeded exponent extension is harmless and not adoptable.
units: SI: m, s, m/s, m/s^2, rad. A fix is [azimuth, elevation(, range)] of the inertial direction ship -> target: azimuth = atan2(d_y, d_x) in (-pi, pi], elevation = asin(d_z / |d|). sigma is per component; sigma_az carries the 1 / cos(elevation) of an isotropic pointing error. Attitudes are unit quaternions [w, x, y, z], body to inertial. Accelerometer samples are [f_x, f_y, f_z] in the body frame.
frame: Right-handed inertial. Gauge: body A at the origin and at rest at t = 0 of every attempt (spec 3.4). Body frame: +x forward, +y left, +z up.

propagation.note: Reference setting; all times are multiples of dt. Any propagator whose position error over the arc is below ~1 m reproduces the expected values.

tolerance.numeric: Fits with compare = numeric: |x_impl - x_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref per parameter; |sigma_impl / sigma_ref - 1| <= 0.05; |chi2_impl / chi2_ref - 1| <= 0.02; |rho_impl - rho_ref| <= 0.02. Tier L windows: same boundaries (t0, t1, nFixes) and |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.05 sigma_ref. Profile nodes: |g_impl - g_ref| <= 0.1 sigma_ref.
tolerance.qualitative: Fits with compare = qualitative are grossly misfitted (chi2/nu > 25) or unconverged; only the inequalities in `checks` and any heldOut.pass value are required.
tolerance.physicalClaims: Per check, stated in `checks`. The generator refuses to write a vector whose claims fail.

notes: `truth` blocks are for checking only and must never reach the estimator (P11). Measurements whose target is not a modelled body are ignored by that fit.
Covariances of positions are [xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz].

attempts.note: Coasting arc around A, r 0.8-1.25 r0, orbit inclined 50 deg to the x-y plane (node at 30 deg); fixes every 180 s.

fits.description: Newtonian model: 6-state, mu.A with its arrival prior, camera misalignment (three components, prior only).
Exponent extension enabled although truth is Newtonian.
